# FieldGroup { #anylumino.FieldGroup }

```python
FieldGroup(children=None, *, label='', orientation='horizontal', **kwargs)
```

Group child controls into a horizontal or vertical field layout.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                            | Default        |
|-------------|----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| children    | optional | Child anywidgets or keyed child mapping rendered inside the component. | `None`         |
| label       | optional | Accessible label or visible label, depending on the component.         | `''`           |
| orientation | optional | Component orientation such as ``'horizontal'`` or ``'vertical'``.      | `'horizontal'` |
